title: Words of a card
description: A file under data/print/<lang>/card/: the words a paper of this language shows for a card, in the shape its card's layout gives them. The words every print shows live in card/base/entity/, one file per card; a print whose words differ holds its own file beside the base, at card/<set>/<number>.json. This file points at one schema per layout. Flavor text is not here: it belongs to the print.
